lessons.title: maātaraā caihana paraicaya
lessons.subtitle: Matra Chinh Parichay
lessons.description: savaraoṃ kae akaelae laikhanae para unakaī apanaī alaga pahacaāna haotaī haai, laekaina jaba vae kaisaī vayañajana kae saātha mailatae haaiṃ, tao vae maātaraā caihana bana jaātae haaiṃ।
lessons.description_english: When vowels are written independently they have their own distinct form, but when they combine with a consonant, they become matra signs.

lessons.title: a - kaoī maātaraā nahaīṃ
lessons.subtitle: a-dhavanai
lessons.description: jaba kaoī vayañajana akaelaā khaḍaā haotaā haai, tao usakae saātha aṃtaranaihaita 'a' dhavanai haotaī haai
lessons.description_english: When a consonant stands alone, it carries the inherent 'a' sound with no visible matra sign.

lessons.title: ā - maātaraā caihana
lessons.subtitle: ā-maātaraā
lessons.description: ā dhavanai kaā maātaraā caihana, vayañajana kae baāda lagataā haai
lessons.description_english: The matra sign for the 'aa' sound is placed after the consonant.

lessons.title: i - maātaraā caihana
lessons.subtitle: i-maātaraā
lessons.description: i dhavanai kaā maātaraā caihana, vayañajana sae pahalae/ūpara lagataā haai
lessons.description_english: The matra sign for the 'i' sound is placed before or above the consonant.

lessons.title: ī - maātaraā caihana
lessons.subtitle: ī-maātaraā
lessons.description: ī dhavanai kaā maātaraā caihana, vayañajana kae baāda lagataā haai
lessons.description_english: The matra sign for the 'ee' sound is placed after the consonant.

lessons.title: u - maātaraā caihana
lessons.subtitle: u-maātaraā
lessons.description: u dhavanai kaā maātaraā caihana, vayañajana kae naīcae lagataā haai
lessons.description_english: The matra sign for the 'u' sound is placed below the consonant.

lessons.title: ū - maātaraā caihana
lessons.subtitle: ū-maātaraā
lessons.description: ū dhavanai kaā maātaraā caihana, vayañajana kae naīcae lagataā haai
lessons.description_english: The matra sign for the 'uu' sound is placed below the consonant.

lessons.title: e - maātaraā caihana
lessons.subtitle: e-maātaraā
lessons.description: e dhavanai kaā maātaraā caihana, vayañajana kae baāda lagataā haai
lessons.description_english: The matra sign for the 'e' sound is placed after the consonant.

lessons.title: ai - maātaraā caihana
lessons.subtitle: ai-maātaraā
lessons.description: ai dhavanai kaā maātaraā caihana, vayañajana kae baāda lagataā haai
lessons.description_english: The matra sign for the 'ai' sound is placed after the consonant.

lessons.title: o - maātaraā caihana
lessons.subtitle: o-maātaraā
lessons.description: o dhavanai kaā maātaraā caihana, vayañajana kae baāda lagataā haai
lessons.description_english: The matra sign for the 'o' sound is placed after the consonant.

lessons.title: au - maātaraā caihana
lessons.subtitle: au-maātaraā
lessons.description: au dhavanai kaā maātaraā caihana, vayañajana kae baāda lagataā haai
lessons.description_english: The matra sign for the 'au' sound is placed after the consonant.

lessons.title: aṃ - anausavaāra
lessons.subtitle: anausavaāra
lessons.description: anausavaāra - naāsaikaā dhavanai caihana, vayañajana kae ūpara lagataā haai
lessons.description_english: Anusvara — a nasal sound sign placed above the consonant.

lessons.title: aḥ - vaisaraga
lessons.subtitle: vaisaraga
lessons.description: vaisaraga - daūsaraī naāsaikaā dhavanai, vayañajana kae baāda lagataā haai
lessons.description_english: Visarga — an aspirate sound sign placed after the consonant.

matraRules.title: savataṃtara savara (Independent Vowel)
matraRules.description: jaba savara śabada kae āramabha maeṃ athavaā akaelaā hao, tao vae apanaā savataṃtara raūpa laetae haaiṃ।
matraRules.descriptionEnglish: When a vowel appears at the beginning of a word or stands alone, it takes its independent form.

matraRules.title: maātaraā caihana (Matra Sign)
matraRules.description: jaba savara kaisaī vayañajana kae baāda ātaā haai, tao vaha maātaraā bana jaātaā haai aura vayañajana sae jauḍakara laikhaā jaātaā haai।
matraRules.descriptionEnglish: When a vowel follows a consonant, it becomes a matra and is written attached to the consonant.

matraRules.title: maātaraā kaā sathaāna (Matra Position)
matraRules.description: maātaraāeṃ vaibhainana sathaānaoṃ para lagataī haaiṃ: ūpara, naīcae, āgae, paīchae।
matraRules.descriptionEnglish: Matras are placed in different positions: above, below, before, or after the consonant.

matraRules.title: vaiśaeṣa dhayaāna (Special Note)
matraRules.description: baraāhamaī maeṃ maātaraāoṃ kaā ākaāra aura sathaāna, daevanaāgaraī sae kaucha paृthaka haai। dhayaāna sae daekhaeṃ, ṭaraesa karaeṃ aura pahacaānaeṃ।
matraRules.descriptionEnglish: In Brahmi, the shape and position of matras differ slightly from Devanagari. Look carefully, trace, and practice recognizing them.
examples: Devanagari: कि (i-matra before consonant) → Brahmi: 𑀓𑀹 (placed above/before consonant)
Devanagari: कु (u-matra below consonant) → Brahmi: 𑀓𑀻 (placed below consonant)
Devanagari: का (aa-matra after consonant) → Brahmi: 𑀓𑀸 (placed after consonant)

matras.descriptionEnglish: Without any matra sign, the consonant carries the inherent 'a' sound.

exercise1.title: paūraā kaījaie (Fill in the blank)
exercise1.description: khaālaī jagaha maeṃ sahaī maātaraā kaā naāma bharaie
exercise1.format: Fill in the matra name for each combination

exercise2.title: sahaī mailaāna kaījaie (Match the correct pair)
exercise2.description: baraāhamaī raūpaoṃ kao daevanaāgaraī sae maela karaeṃ
exercise2.instructions: Match Brahmi matra combinations with Devanagari

exercise3.title: ulaṭaā abhayaāsa (Reverse exercise)
exercise3.description: baraāhamaī raūpa kao daekhakara maātaraā kaī pahacaāna karaeṃ
exercise3.instructions: Identify which matra is used in each Brahmi form
exercise3.format: Brahmi to Devanagari with matra identification

exercise4.title: ṭaraesaiṃga abhayaāsa (Tracing practice)
exercise4.description: paratayaeka raūpa kao 3 baāra laikhanae kaā abhayaāsa karaeṃ

tracingSequence.description: baraāhamaī maātaraā raūpa: kaucha bhaī nahaīṃ lagataā। udaāharaṇa: ka (𑀓)
tracingSequence.descriptionEnglish: Brahmi matra form: Nothing is added. Example: ka (𑀓)
tracingSequence.instructions: dhayaāna sae daekhaeṃ kai yaha kaaisae laikhaā jaātaā haai

tracingSequence.description: ā-maātaraā: vayañajana kae baāda lagataā haai। udaāharaṇa: kaā (𑀓𑀸)
tracingSequence.descriptionEnglish: AA matra: Placed after consonant. Example: kaā (𑀓𑀸)
tracingSequence.instructions: maātaraā kao vayañajana sae jaoḍakara laikhaeṃ

tracingSequence.description: i-maātaraā: vayañajana sae pahalae/ūpara lagataā haai। udaāharaṇa: kai (𑀓𑀹)
tracingSequence.descriptionEnglish: i matra: Placed before/above consonant. Example: kai (𑀓𑀹)
tracingSequence.instructions: maātaraā kao vayañajana kae saātha sahaī jagaha para laikhaeṃ

tracingSequence.description: ī-maātaraā: vayañajana kae baāda lagataā haai। udaāharaṇa: kaī (𑀓𑀺)
tracingSequence.descriptionEnglish: ee matra: Placed after consonant. Example: kaī (𑀓𑀺)
tracingSequence.instructions: maātaraā kao vayañajana sae jaoḍakara laikhaeṃ

tracingSequence.description: u-maātaraā: vayañajana kae naīcae lagataā haai। udaāharaṇa: kau (𑀓𑀻)
tracingSequence.descriptionEnglish: U matra: Placed below consonant. Example: kau (𑀓𑀻)
tracingSequence.instructions: vayañajana kae naīcae maātaraā lagaākara laikhaeṃ

tracingSequence.description: ū-maātaraā: vayañajana kae naīcae lagataā haai। udaāharaṇa: kaū (𑀓𑀼)
tracingSequence.descriptionEnglish: UU matra: Placed below consonant. Example: kaū (𑀓𑀼)
tracingSequence.instructions: vayañajana kae naīcae maātaraā lagaākara laikhaeṃ

tracingSequence.description: e-maātaraā: vayañajana kae baāda lagataā haai। udaāharaṇa: kae (𑀓𑁂)
tracingSequence.descriptionEnglish: E matra: Placed after consonant. Example: kae (𑀓𑁂)
tracingSequence.instructions: maātaraā kao vayañajana sae jaoḍakara laikhaeṃ

tracingSequence.description: ai-maātaraā: vayañajana kae baāda lagataā haai। udaāharaṇa: kaai (𑀓𑁃)
tracingSequence.descriptionEnglish: AI matra: Placed after consonant. Example: kaai (𑀓𑁃)
tracingSequence.instructions: maātaraā kao vayañajana sae jaoḍakara laikhaeṃ

tracingSequence.description: o-maātaraā: vayañajana kae baāda lagataā haai। udaāharaṇa: kao (𑀓𑁄)
tracingSequence.descriptionEnglish: O matra: Placed after consonant. Example: kao (𑀓𑁄)
tracingSequence.instructions: maātaraā kao vayañajana sae jaoḍakara laikhaeṃ

tracingSequence.description: au-maātaraā: vayañajana kae baāda lagataā haai। udaāharaṇa: kaau (𑀓𑁅)
